name: ATS-friendly Resume Template
description: A free, editable resume starter with a simple single-column layout and standard section headings. Includes a Word document (.docx), a matching plain-text copy and short customization instructions in one ZIP download. Replace the bracketed placeholders with your own details, skills and accomplishments. No tables, text boxes, photos or decorative graphics are embedded in the resume. Follow the employer's requested file format and review any fields filled automatically after uploading.

name: My Market Day Busy Book
description: An interactive busy book for ages 2–6. Find colors at the fruit stall, match shapes and animals, count groups of fruit, then cut and paste picture pieces with a grown-up.

name: My First Pencil Paths
description: An alphabet and tracing workbook for ages 3–6. Follow pre-writing paths, trace uppercase and lowercase letters and numbers, then practice handwriting and your own name.

name: Point, Say & Play
description: Educational flashcards for ages 1–6. Explore animals, occupations, transportation, body parts, emotions and first words with a grown-up.
